entry = rlm.harness.create_memory(title='ARC periodic parallel stripes from intercept residues', path='arc', global_=True, content='''For ARC grids made of sparse, full-length parallel colored stripes, fill the whole grid with the periodic stripe pattern encoded by their intercepts. Identify the stripe invariant: horizontal rows use r; down-right diagonals (slope +1) use d=c-r; down-left diagonals (slope -1) use s=r+c. Each observed stripe at invariant k with color v constrains the output stripe class k mod P to v. Choose the smallest period P for which no residue class has conflicting colors (often equals the number of distinct stripe tracks); then output v at every cell whose invariant has the corresponding residue. If multiple tracks share a color, they still represent distinct residues if their intercepts differ. Example (26x26): source tracks d=c-r: color 5 at d=9, color 4 at d=-2, color 3 at d=-9 and -8. P=4, residues 1->5, 2->4, 3->3, 0->3, so output is fully filled with f((c-r) mod 4). Similar demos: row stripes output periodic in r; down-left stripes periodic in r+c. Verify intercepts carefully: a thick diagonal band may correspond to adjacent parallel tracks (e.g. d=-9 and -8), not offsets guessed from its upper edge.''')
